headline: Three-Year-Old Girl Assaulted in Goa
summary: A young toddler was sexually assaulted inside an abandoned building in Goa and hospitalized, prompting a manhunt for the suspect. A state minister controversially blamed outsiders for the vast majority of such crimes.

headline: Toddler Raped in Abandoned Goa Building
summary: Police have launched a manhunt for the perpetrator who sexually assaulted a young child in an abandoned structure. The incident has drawn strong condemnation from officials and child rights advocates highlighting security lapses.

headline: Minister Attributes Most Assaults to Outsiders
summary: Following the sexual assault of a young child in Goa, a government minister claimed that outsiders are responsible for 90% of such crimes. Authorities are actively searching for the absconding suspect.

headline: AAP Questions Inaction Over Job Scam
summary: The Aam Aadmi Party has criticized authorities for failing to apprehend the main accused in an ongoing excise job scam. AAP members filed an RTI to expose further details regarding the unresolved case.

headline: Transgender Community Added to OBC List
summary: The Goa government has officially included the transgender community in the state's Other Backward Classes list. This inclusion grants them access to various reservation and welfare benefits.

headline: Ration Cards Temporarily Suspended
summary: The civil supplies department clarified that ration cards have only been temporarily suspended rather than permanently cancelled. Beneficiaries have been advised to resolve verification issues to restore services.

headline: Whale Rescued at Mandrem Beach
summary: A stranded whale that washed ashore on Mandrem Beach was successfully rescued and released back into the open sea. A video of the rescue operation drew widespread attention online.

headline: Margao Fish Market Flagged for Violations
summary: Inspectors identified multiple safety and sanitation violations at the Margao fish market, raising concerns among local vendors and shoppers. Authorities faced criticism for neglecting hygiene standards.

headline: Manhunt Launched After Toddler Assault
summary: Goa police have deployed search teams to capture the individual responsible for raping a toddler in an empty building. The shocking case has sparked outrage across the region.

headline: Goa Beach Ranks Among World's Best
summary: A popular Goa beach has been crowned Asia's top beach and secured a spot in the global top ten rankings. The recognition highlights the region's enduring appeal to international travelers.

headline: Tillari Canal Repairs Deferred to 2027
summary: The state government has pushed back scheduled repairs for the second Tillari canal until 2027. Officials did not immediately provide detailed reasons for the delay in maintenance.

headline: CCTV Gaps Hinder Toddler Assault Probe
summary: Investigators probing the sexual assault of a toddler in Mapusa are facing challenges due to a lack of working CCTV cameras in the area. Police are appealing for alternative witness leads.

headline: Road Trip to Goa in Mahindra Scorpio
summary: Travel enthusiasts shared their experiences of taking a quick road trip to Goa in a Mahindra Scorpio to unwind. The journey highlights popular scenic routes for weekend travelers.

headline: New Vande Bharat Express to Goa
summary: A new Vande Bharat Express connecting Bengaluru and Goa has been approved to begin regular operations on November 15. The route will pass through several coastal towns including Mangaluru and Karwar.

headline: Parab to Rejoin Regional Party
summary: Former Revolutionary Goans Party president Manoj Parab is scheduled to officially make his political comeback to the party on November 22. Supporters are preparing for his re-entry event.

headline: Exploring Quieter Escapes Over Goa
summary: Travel publications are highlighting serene coastal stretches along the Arabian Sea as quieter alternatives to traditional hotspots like Goa and the Maldives. These destinations cater to travelers seeking slow-paced getaways.

headline: Inside Guide to IFFI Goa
summary: Organizers and travel guides have released previews for the upcoming IFFI Goa festival, emphasizing events and attractions beyond traditional film screenings. The festival draws cinema enthusiasts from around the world.

headline: Vande Bharat Service Receives Mixed Reviews
summary: While the newly approved Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Express has been welcomed by commuters in Mangaluru, some travelers feel the journey duration is too long for Goa-bound passengers.

headline: SGPDA Market Cleanup Criticized
summary: A recent cleanliness drive at the SGPDA market failed to satisfy locals, who pointed to persistent underlying civic neglect. Residents are demanding more permanent infrastructure solutions.

headline: Fire Damages Assagao Shop and Vehicles
summary: A sudden fire in Assagao left four individuals injured and completely gutted four vehicles parked near a local shop. Emergency responders quickly arrived at the scene to control the blaze.

headline: Goa to Send Athletes to Macau
summary: The state has confirmed that two local athletes will represent Goa at upcoming sporting events in Macau. Officials wished the competitors success ahead of their departure.

headline: Margao Railway Station Upgrade Planned
summary: Plans have been finalized to implement a major modernization and upgrade project at the Margao railway station. The development aims to improve passenger amenities and station infrastructure.

headline: KTC Workers' Strike Call Deferred
summary: Transport corporation workers in Goa have decided to postpone their planned strike that was scheduled for November 12. Talks between union representatives and management are expected to continue.

headline: Chhetri Enters FIFA Impact Programme
summary: Indian football star Sunil Chhetri has become the first male player to be included in FIFA’s Player Impact Programme. The recognition highlights his lasting contributions to the sport.

headline: Mobile Unit Deployed for Air Quality Check
summary: Following post-Diwali air quality index readings hitting 155 in Panaji, authorities deployed a mobile testing unit to monitor pollution levels. Officials are analyzing the primary causes behind the spike.

headline: GSCERT to Review Common Exam Results
summary: The GSCERT will conduct an in-depth analysis of student performance for Grades I and II following their first common examination. The evaluation aims to identify learning gaps among early-grade students.

headline: Opposition Outcry Over Ministership
summary: The inclusion of Congress turncoat Sankalp Amonkar into the Goa cabinet has triggered strong condemnation from opposition parties. Critics have questioned the political ethics behind the ministerial appointment.

headline: Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Launch Set
summary: Regular commercial services for the Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Express are officially scheduled to flag off on November 15. Prime Minister Modi and the Railway Minister are expected to inaugurate the line.

headline: Vande Bharat Inauguration Scheduled
summary: High-ranking officials, including the Prime Minister and Railway Minister, are slated to launch the new Vande Bharat Express route connecting Bengaluru, Mangaluru, and Goa in mid-November.

headline: Parab Prepares for RGP Comeback
summary: Former Revolutionary Goans Party president Manoj Parab is set to rejoin the political fold later this month. His return is expected to energize party supporters ahead of upcoming political engagements.

headline: Scenic Road Trip from Arambol to Mumbai
summary: Travel bloggers documented their 540-kilometer road trip experience driving from Arambol in Goa to Mumbai. The detailed route summary provides tips for scenic coastal driving.

headline: Palolem Beach Crowned Asia's Best
summary: Palolem Beach in Goa has secured the top spot as Asia's best beach and ranked sixth globally in recent travel rankings. The accolade celebrates its pristine coastline and scenic beauty.

headline: Vande Bharat Praised for Connectivity
summary: The new railway connection between Karnataka and Goa has been hailed as a major boost for travelers in Mangaluru despite concerns over the overall journey length. The semi-high-speed train promises faster transit times.

headline: Transgender Community Gains OBC Status
summary: The Goa government has formally extended reservation benefits to the transgender community by adding them to the state OBC list. Social welfare groups have praised the decision as a step toward inclusivity.

headline: News Report Reunites Long-Lost Family
summary: A local media report published by OHeraldo successfully helped reunite a Goan family that had been separated for decades. Relatives expressed deep gratitude for the publication's intervention.

headline: AAP Files RTI in Fake Job Case
summary: The Aam Aadmi Party has filed an RTI application to investigate alleged police inaction in a Rs 52 lakh fake excise appointment scam. Opposition leaders are demanding immediate arrests of those involved.

headline: Goa Offers Subsidy for Cattle Rearing
summary: The Goa government has introduced a daily subsidy of ₹150 per cow to encourage residents to rear cattle instead of abandoning them on streets. Chief Minister Pramod Sawant urged citizens to utilize the scheme.

headline: Bondada Group Plans Renewable Investment
summary: The Bondada Group has announced plans to invest Rs 30 billion into renewable energy infrastructure projects in Goa. The massive investment aims to boost clean energy generation across the region.

headline: CM Vows Strict Punishment in Assault Case
summary: In the wake of the sexual assault of a toddler, Goa's Chief Minister has vowed to pursue a permanent prison term for the accused. The government faced mounting pressure to ensure swift justice.

headline: Techie Turns Baker in Goa
summary: A former tech professional shared her journey of quitting her corporate job to establish a successful cake business in Goa within a year. Her story highlights the growing trend of corporate professionals relocating to launch startups.

headline: BJP Accuses Congress of Appeasement
summary: The Bharatiya Janata Party has criticized the Congress party for allegedly mixing festival celebrations with appeasement politics. The verbal spat highlights rising political tensions in the state.

headline: Woman Dies After Mandrem Accident
summary: A woman succumbed to her injuries days after being involved in a scooter accident in Mandrem. Local authorities are investigating the circumstances surrounding the crash.

headline: Poultry Bodies Seek Government Support
summary: Poultry industry representatives have appealed to the state government for financial assistance and policy support to boost local production. Producers cited rising operational costs as a major hurdle.

headline: Goan Team Prepares for Music Convention
summary: A 31-member Goan singing delegation is rehearsing intensively ahead of the upcoming Mangaluru Konkani Music Convention. The group aims to showcase traditional coastal music and culture.

headline: Panel Calls for Better Child Safety
summary: The state child rights panel has emphasized the urgent need for Goa to strengthen its child safety and protection mechanisms. The recommendation follows a series of recent crimes against minors.

headline: Police Halt Festival Over Permits
summary: Calangute police intervened to halt the Krishna Vijay Utsav event due to missing permits and licensing issues. Organizers were asked to secure proper clearances before proceeding.

headline: High Court Orders Halt on Construction
summary: The Goa High Court has ordered an immediate halt to construction activities at a Cavelossim property following allegations of illegal sand dune flattening. Environmental activists welcomed the swift judicial intervention.

headline: Anticipatory Bail Rejected in Dog Case
summary: A local court has rejected the anticipatory bail plea filed by Goa Yuva Forward president Meshu D’Costa in connection with the Sanguem dead dog case. Police continue to investigate the incident.

headline: Palolem Ranks Among Global Beaches
summary: Palolem Beach has achieved international recognition by ranking sixth among the top 25 beaches worldwide. The accolade underscores Goa's enduring popularity among global beachgoers.

headline: Brothers Cheated in Job Scam
summary: Two brothers in Goa were allegedly defrauded of Rs 12 lakh by fraudsters promising government employment. Local police have registered a case and initiated a search for the suspects.
